name: Remy
source:
An employee of the Ministry of Culture & Arts, Remy is an individual with a pronounced sense of duty and commitment. Some people would call him a librarian, though he would be quick to correct anyone asserting such a thing. He is not a mere book sorter, but a scholar who takes his job very seriously.

[From [url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/angels-with-scaly-wings--3#/]Indiegogo[/url]]
